latestAction.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S7755-7756; text: CR S7755)

summary.text: This resolution designates October 26, 2025, as the Day of the Deployed in honor of the deployed members of the Armed Forces and their families.

title: A resolution designating October 26, 2025, as the "Day of the Deployed".
